summary: Reproduced the review counterexample on the exact candidate: context_len=10 with 11 reserved tokens returned after truncating prompt and completion to zero while retaining an accounted total of 11. Preserved the candidate's feasible reserved-token accounting and added an explicit rejection when the immutable reserved-token budget alone exceeds context.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before: the candidate accepted prompt=0, completion=0, reserved=11, accounted_total=11 with context_len=10; the probe's invariant assertion failed. Raw output: evidence/candidate-failing-before.txt.
The candidate's valid fixes and adjacent compatibility tests passed: 11 tests and 11 subtests. Raw output: evidence/candidate-valid-tests.txt.

Passing-after: 13 tests and 11 subtests passed, including completion truncation, disabled compatibility, feasible reserved-token accounting, reserved==context, and reserved>context rejection. Raw output: evidence/unit-after.txt.

Passing-after: the exact context=10/reserved=11 counterexample is rejected with a precise ValueError because truncation cannot reduce the reserved budget. Raw output: evidence/adversarial-passing-after.txt.
No whitespace errors in the consolidated change.

gpu_execution.evidence: The corrected code is deterministic Python request-budget validation. No compatible EAGLE draft model was available to exercise nonzero reserved tokens end-to-end; the tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify that architecture-specific path. The candidate's existing GPU HTTP artifact used speculative_algorithm=None and therefore did not cover this counterexample.

remaining_limitations: No compatible EAGLE speculative draft model or weights were available, so nonzero reserved-token behavior was validated directly at TokenizerManager rather than end-to-end on GPU.
The deterministic tiny-Llama fixture validates transport and engine execution only and cannot validate the EAGLE-specific reserved-token path.
No native source changed, so native rebuild and compiler/ISA validation were not applicable.
Independent GPU numerical comparison is not applicable to request-length control flow.
